children: Flux Power Holdings' Chief Operating Officer Jeff Mason has submitted his resignation, effective as of Sept. 25.
Mason submitted his resignation on Sept. 8, Flux Power said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing on Friday.
A payment of $5,000 will be made to Mason within ten days of the execution of his separation agreement, subject to the non-revocation of a general release of claims in favor of the company.
Based in Vista, Calif., Flux Power is a developer of advanced lithium-ion energy storage solutions and fleet intelligence technology.
